text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim and repeated \"I would not want to buy the car\"","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"This captures how directly the essay states a position and keeps returning to it throughout the response."},{"evidence":"\"Reason being is what would happen if the car has a glitch...\" and \"what then would I blame the company\"","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"This captures how the essay explains its claim with cause-and-effect thinking rather than just listing opinions."},{"evidence":"price concern and blame/liability questions in separate points","quality":"organized support","description":"This captures how the essay develops multiple distinct reasons in a more controlled structure."},{"evidence":"\"As amazing as never driving a car sounds\" and \"Think about it\"","quality":"persuasive tone","description":"This captures how the essay uses direct rhetorical language to engage the reader and strengthen its opposition."},{"evidence":"mentions of \"glitch,\" \"ditch,\" \"blame the company,\" and \"safety concerns\"","quality":"specificity of concern","description":"This captures how the essay names concrete risks tied to driverless cars instead of staying at a general level."}]}
